observed_scope: Current official API lists unknown status and no results. The planned psychometric battery includes Epworth sleepiness. The Dretsch 2014 abstract (PMID24690964) calls the placebo corn-oil ethyl esters and supplies no NCT identifier or arm-level Epworth estimate. The exact linkage and comparator formulation remain open.

The official registry lists 3 g/day of a 50:50 soy–corn placebo blend and no posted results. The final publication abstract and supplement for PMID39181037 report 2 g/day. The paper lists gait speed and balance without giving their numerical estimates in the abstract. The comparator is mixed oil and the trial population has COPD.

The completed osteoarthritis registry still has no posted results. The published abstract reports less fatigue after oil procedures, but the matched-placebo fatigue comparisons and full numerical estimates remain inaccessible.

The official protocol specifies FACIT-F at baseline and months one and two. The completed SLE trial tests a combined botanical and micronutrient intervention, without a separate ground Nigella seed comparison. The registry has no posted results. Official protocol: https://cdn.clinicaltrials.gov/large-docs/85/NCT07398885/Prot_000.pdf

The official API was updated November 25, 2026. The trial remains recruiting with no posted results. Its named primary outcomes are cognitive tasks. The posted record gives no dedicated Parkinson bradykinesia result.
